title: A member asks a question, and the app opens the page that answers it

criteria.text: Ask bar: one text box on every signed-in page that takes a question in plain words
criteria.note: Not built: no ask bar anywhere in src [V grep]. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1192.

criteria.text: Routing: one cheap model call turns the question into one page plus its filters, and the app opens it
criteria.note: Not built. The only model calls in the repo are moderation's (F100) [A]. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1193.

criteria.text: Fallback: if the call fails, times out or finds no page, the question runs as an ordinary search
criteria.note: Not built. Explore search exists (#924, #934) and is the fallback it would use [V]. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1194.

criteria.text: Deep links: every page and every filter it supports can be reached by URL
criteria.note: Not built as a set. Explore carries `?q=`, `?view=`, `?reach=`, `?area=`, `?metro=` and You carries `?tab=` [V smoke LIVE_PATHS, load.ts]; a post draft with prefilled text and a date or category filter by URL do not exist [A]; Explore's header search now writes its words to the one box in the URL (#1161), which is one more deep link but not a registry [V]. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1195.

criteria.text: One page registry: a single list in the code describes each page, its URL and its filters; the router reads only that list
criteria.note: Not built: no page registry in src [V grep]. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1196.

criteria.text: Nothing is done for the member: the router only opens pages; a prefilled draft is not posted until the member posts it
criteria.note: Not built; needs a standing guard once the router exists. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1197.

criteria.text: Questions logged by the search-demand rules (F089): anonymous, aggregated with a floor of ten members in one metro, raw rows deleted after 30 days, never tied to a member
criteria.note: Not built. F089's search-demand log is its own scenario; whether it is built is not this report's claim [A]. Search-demand logging itself exists (`search-demand-actions.ts`, shown on /admin/metrics) [V grep]; F089 stays a draft scenario. Rechecked 2026-11-06 [V grep]. Filed #1198.

criteria.text: Opt-out: one setting stops a member's questions being logged; routing still works for them
Cost cap: a per-member daily limit on model calls, after which the bar falls back to search
